eld.text: Will Kenrith and his twin sister Rowan set out at eighteen on a quest to find their father, the High King, after Will has a vision in the ice and the twins wonder whether a stag in it can lead them to him.
Garruk saves the twins from redcaps at Oko's behest, but when Will removes the hedron from Garruk the curse runs wild and Garruk rampages and falls into the river.
Will dives in to save him, and his persistence summons the Cauldron of Eternity, which lifts Garruk's curse.
Linden restores the High King, and the shock of learning the truth about their origins ignites the twins' shared spark, so they disappear to a new plane.

stx.text: Will Kenrith leaves Kylem for Strixhaven with Rowan after Kasmina's invitation, and the twins arrive on Arcavios, where Kasmina welcomes them to the school.
Their combined ice and lightning spells fail to blend smoothly, and Rowan soon says she will live her own life, leaving Will to find answers alone.
The twins stop speaking for weeks after Will confronts her about her studies, and they fight at the Mage Tower match, where Rowan shocks him and he freezes her boots.

When the Oriq attack, Will casts a control spell on the Blood Avatar with Rowan's last energy, and the Blood Avatar crushes Extus Narr but severs Will's right leg below the knee as it is pulled back into the Snarl.

woe.text: Will Kenrith takes up his father's sword and seeks peace after declaring himself High King, while Rowan believes she can gain enough magical power to restore things after the Invasion, when the twins unknowingly lose their shared spark.
Will duels the rebel knight Imodane, and when she is about to strike him down, Rowan cuts a rift into a mountain, sending Imodane fleeing.
Rowan leaves to find a cure for the Wicked Slumber, and when Will pleads with her to come home, she says home is gone.
With Kellan's help, Will strikes Ashiok with a bolt of ice and then captures Eriette, ending the curse, though Rowan escapes.
